forcedChoices.reason: Here 'actual' means existing, now-inhabited worlds as against prehuman or settled ones, not the philosophical 'actual' of the glossary (en acto).
The English ordinal suffix 'th' becomes the Spanish ordinal mark inside the same <sup> tag.
The English units (feet) are kept as units, not converted, so the numbers stay as in the text.

forcedChoices.choice: Los hijos ... el varón y la mujer
forcedChoices.reason: 'Young' as offspring of a human type; 'male and female' as the two sexes, not limited to adults by 'hombre'.
'all indwelt beings' refers back to the Adjuster in the same sentence; Spanish needs a short referential form.
'passing by' and 'pass by' mean that they skip those worlds, not that they travel past them.
